screen: Deck's own screen. Quick Access page 854x454 css px, dpr 1.5. No game running. No monitor.

setup.setting_used: Settings tab, 'Show one chip instead of two' (key preset_single_chip). The runbook's first choice, 'Show on-screen debug HUD', is not on the Settings tab (no 'HUD' text on the tab), so the one-chip setting was used as the runbook says. Found true.

pressed: Five times: reopen the panel, walk Down to the toggle one press at a time (read focus: 'Show one chip instead of two', visible 100%), press A, then press the Quick Access chord (GUIDE hold, A tap). Then once through a popup: walk to 'Accent intensity: Strong', read focus, A (menu opened, ring on 'Light', read), A on 'Light' (menu closed, screen rebuilt, ring on 'Accent intensity: Light', read), then the close chord at once.

seen.timing_deviation: The A press and the close chord were sent as two tool calls in one batch, back to back. The rig's chord tool is a separate call from the single-button press, and a sequence cannot hold a chord, so the gap could not be held to 300 ms and was not measured (the bridge acks the A press with a clock value but gives none for the chord). Each A-then-chord pair went out in the same message. The result still shows the settings write beat the close each time.
seen.diff_after_5: only preset_single_chip (false vs true) differs from the copy (plus the file's trailing newline).
seen.popup_trial: ai_character_accent_intensity went heavy -> subtle in the file by 3 s after the close chord. Diff against the copy then showed exactly two keys: ai_character_accent_intensity (subtle vs heavy) and preset_single_chip (false vs true).
seen.put_back: Accent set back to 'Strong' by its own menu (read focus on the 'Strong' item first, then A); file read heavy. Toggle set back to on (read focus first, then A); file read true. Final file diff against deck/p78-quickclose-before.json: identical.
seen.other: One deck_openPlugin after the 3rd trial failed with a COM7 serial-port error on this PC (bridge busy) and worked on the next call; nothing was pressed by the failed call.

expected: The file holds the new value 5 of 5; a diff against the copy shows only the keys changed; the popup change also lands.
verdict: PASS: 5 of 5 toggles were in the file 3 s after A + close chord; the diff showed only the changed key.
PASS: the popup change (accent intensity, closed popup then closed Quick Access at once) was in the file; the diff showed only the two keys changed.
UNCLEAR (timing): the gap between A and the close chord was not held to 300 ms and was not measured; it was probably about one tool-call round trip. A faster gap could behave differently.
side_effect: Settings were changed and put back as listed; final file identical to the copy. The chip row switched to two chips and back during the check. The plugin was never reloaded.
